matches.rationale: Pred 1 directly targets Eq. 11's claim of 'positive weights that sum to 1' and formally refutes it, showing λv^t+λc^t<1 whenever other tokens carry attention mass — the same locus and the same underlying inconsistency (claimed balanced fusion vs. actual ill-defined weighting) as GT1, even though the mechanism described differs (R2 permits this).

No finding addresses the specific claim that causal masking is preserved during attention reallocation; pred 3 examines a different aspect (renormalization/softmax quotient mismatch) of a differently-labeled equation and actually confirms the zero-preservation (causal) property holds, so it does not detect GT2's defect.

Identifies a real arithmetic inconsistency in Table 2's harmonic-mean column, but this is not among the listed ground-truth defects.
Confirms (rather than refutes) causal-mask preservation and instead flags a separate renormalization/softmax mismatch, which is a different, unlisted issue.
Points out a genuine averaging discrepancy in Table 4 that is not part of the two listed ground-truth defects.
